s.t: Du Blonde has said ‘Take One For The Team’ sounds joyful but is really about a stalker, delivered with her usual dark sense of humour.
s.src: Du Blonde on “Homecoming” and Overcoming the Pitfalls of the Music Industry (Under the Radar)
s.q: Like "Take One For the Team" sounds kind of joyful but it's about a stalker and abuse. But I do tend to deliver things with a dark sense of humor.

f.t: She wrote her third album, Homecoming, on a guitar given to her by the Curb Your Enthusiasm actor Jeff Garlin.
f.q: It makes sense that Du Blonde's third album was written on a guitar given to her by Curb Your Enthusiasm actor Jeff Garlin.

f.t: Seeing the V&A’s ‘David Bowie Is’ exhibition made up her mind to reinvent herself as Du Blonde: ‘it was almost like the decision was made for me right there’.
f.src: Du Blonde interview: Beth Jeans Houghton on artistic reinvention and new album Welcome Back To Milk (NME)
f.q: it was almost like the decision [to change] was made for me right there. I didn’t question it.

f.t: Earlier in her career she was locked out of the mixing sessions for her own album because the label said she was being difficult.
f.src: Du Blonde on “Homecoming” and Overcoming the Pitfalls of the Music Industry (Under the Radar)
f.q: And then I got locked out of the mixing sessions because the label said I was being difficult!

f.t: She spent only about seven grand making Homecoming, and had already made the money back.
f.src: Du Blonde on “Homecoming” and Overcoming the Pitfalls of the Music Industry (Under the Radar)
f.q: The fact that I've made the money back on Homecoming already and I only spent about seven grand on it

f.t: As Beth Jeans Houghton, she directed and illustrated the animated video for the Red Hot Chili Peppers' ‘Sick Love’ in 2016.
f.q: Houghton directed and illustrated the animated music video for "Sick Love"

s.t: Dr. Dog released it on Shame, Shame in 2010; it later exploded on TikTok and became the band’s first Platinum record.
s.src: Dr. Dog Embrace the Present Moment (Paste)
s.q: thanks in part to the unexpected success of “Where’d All The Time Go,” a song from 2010’s Shame, Shame that exploded on TikTok and led to the band’s first Platinum record

s.t: Paste’s Justin Jacobs called it the best track on Dr. Dog’s Shame, Shame, its Mellotron, backing harmonies and quick guitar licks ‘all playing like a Pet Sounds B-side’.
s.src: Dr. Dog: Shame, Shame (Paste review, 7 April 2010)
s.q: to a mellotron undulating like high tide, a wave of backing harmony and a set of quick guitar licks, all playing like a Pet Sounds B-side.

s.t: On record a ‘shadowy soul number’, Dr. Dog’s song turned into ‘thunderous arena-rock’ live in 2010 when new drummer Eric Slick took hold of it.
s.src: Dr. Dog: Stuck in time, and it's all good (Philadelphia Inquirer, 15 May 2010)
s.q: which on record is a shadowy soul number with a positively liberating chorus. Live, however, new drummer and Paul Green School of Rock vet Eric Slick kicked it (and several others) into another dimension - from paisley pastiche to thunderous arena-rock.

f.t: Their break came in 2004, when Scott McMicken handed My Morning Jacket’s Jim James a CD of Toothbrush decorated with rainbow sprinkles, which caught his eye.
f.q: The big break came in 2004 courtesy of My Morning Jacket's Jim James. After a MMJ show in Philadelphia, McMicken gave James a CD of Dr. Dog's tape-recorder experiment Toothbrush. The CD was decorated with rainbow sprinkles that caught James's eye so he gave it a shot and loved it.

f.t: Every member has a nickname beginning with T: former member Andrew ‘Trial’ Jones, for instance, is a licensed attorney.
f.q: each band member has a nickname beginning with the letter T and they have explained that friends of the band also receive nicknames, which are drawn from aspects of their lives and personalities. (Former member Andrew "Trial" Jones, for example, is a licensed attorney.)

f.t: Since early 2015 their song ‘Warrior Man’ has been the entrance music of the wrestler Matt Sydal in Ring of Honor.
f.q: Since early 2015, "Warrior Man" has been the entrance theme for Matt Sydal in the wrestling promotion, Ring Of Honor.

f.t: Scott McMicken recorded sessions for Big Thief’s Dragon New Warm Mountain I Believe In You live with eight microphones, at one point tracking 13 songs in a single day.
f.src: Dr. Dog Embrace the Present Moment (Paste)
f.q: McMicken set up eight mics and recorded the band playing live, at one point tracking 13 songs in a single day.

f.t: Toby Leaman works as a stone mason, a job he says is ‘really just to stay sane’.
f.src: Dr. Dog swore off touring in 2021, but is making an exception for a date at the Mann (Philadelphia Inquirer)
f.q: I actually do have a job — working as a stone mason — but it’s really just to stay sane.

s.t: Life in Film’s ‘Get Closer’ got heavy play on American radio; Rochester station WZNE 94.1 hosted the band’s show at the Bug Jar, with pre-sale tickets at 94 cents.
s.src: Rock: Life in Film - CITY News
s.q: the single “Get Closer” has been getting a heavy spin on American radio ... WZNE 94.1 is hosting the show at the Bug Jar and pre-sale tickets are only 94 cents.

s.t: Life in Film’s ‘Get Closer’ grew from a simple riff on a Casio keyboard and became the first single from their debut album, Here It Comes.
s.src: Exclusive Song Premiere: ‘Get Closer,’ Life In Film - Interview Magazine
s.q: which stemmed from a simple riff on a Casio keyboard and quickly evolved into something more.

s.t: Life in Film recorded it with producer Stephen Street, and Clash singled out its glockenspiel and chiming harmonies when premiering it in January 2015.
s.src: Premiere: Life In Film – ‘Get Closer’ | Clash
s.q: Working with legendary producer Stephen Street, new single ‘Get Closer’ is a sprightly introduction to their charms. ... that glockenspiel for example, or the chiming harmonies.

f.t: Burberry’s Christopher Bailey sought them out after they sent a video of their song ‘Carla’ to a YouTube channel; their ‘Alleyway’ later fronted the Burberry Acoustic initiative.
f.q: The band was sought out by Christopher Bailey, Chief Creative Officer of Burberry, after they sent a video of their performance of their song, "Carla," to Dave Tree's "Watch, Listen, Tell" YouTube channel. ... the song would become "selected as the first track to front the Burberry Acoustic initiative,"

f.t: They played ‘The Idiot’ to open Vogue’s Fashion Night Out on 9 September 2010.
f.q: The band would later perform their song "The Idiot" for the opening of Vogue's Fashion Night Out on 9 September 2010.

f.t: Their single ‘The Idiot’ was produced by Mike Crossey at Liverpool’s Motor Museum studio, and its video was made with the designer Kate Moross.
f.q: It was produced by Mike Crossey at the Motor Museum Liverpool Recording Studio. A music video was released on YouTube with the collaboration of artistic designer, Kate Moross.
